title: POV: You Earn $4,000 a Month and Still Save $800 — Your Coworkers Can't Figure Out How
description:
You and your coworkers get the exact same paycheck. Two weeks later they're broke, and you're calm, with $800 already saved. The difference isn't income. It's one simple plan: the 50/30/20 rule.

In this POV story you'll see how 50% for needs, 30% for wants and 20% for your future plays out over one year and five years, why a car payment can wreck your budget, how to enjoy your money with zero guilt, and exactly how to set up your own 50/30/20 budget tonight.

short2.title: Your Bank Might Charge You $35 For a $4 Coffee 😤
short2.description: Overdraft fees can turn a $4 coffee into a $39 coffee. Here's the 2-minute fix: turn off overdraft coverage for debit card purchases and set a low balance alert.
